exposure: sex matching (fully match, fully mismatch, partial mismatch)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 5788 patients who underwent cardiac surgery between January 2018 and December 2020 and received red blood cell transfusions.
finding: Blood donor sex and BMI significantly influenced outcomes in cardiac surgery patients, with higher donor BMI and certain sex mismatches leading to increased length of hospital stay, mortality, and readmission.
